track: 赛道3：离子通道、GPCR等药靶的小分子药物虚拟筛选
ranking_score: uncalibrated classification ranking score; no affinity unit
BBB_probability: ADMET-AI BBB_Martins endpoint prediction; not measured brain penetration
DILI_hERG_AMES: ADMET-AI predicted adverse endpoint scores; larger indicates more predicted risk
Vina_best_kcal_mol: Vina scoring function output, kcal/mol; not experimentally measured binding free energy
structure_file: path relative to project; SDF atom coordinates in angstrom; docking microstate may differ in charge/tautomer from parent
receptor_file: RCSB 9WIJ mmCIF; prepared chain/atom information retained in associated receptor files
missing_value: blank; no imputation of missing pharmacology or downstream evidence
candidate_status: COMPUTATIONAL_EVIDENCE_INTEGRATED_CANDIDATE: ranked computational candidate from the complete-evidence subset
independent_acceptance: Frozen model independent evaluation flag; separate from candidate cell-experiment status
wet_experiment_scope: Computational screening, evidence integration and result verification
